The Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL) has released the NPCIL Result 2026 on 27th June for various posts under Kakrapar Gujarat Site recruitment. The result was announced for 197 vacancies including Stipendiary Trainee/Scientific Assistant, Stipendiary Trainee/Technician and Assistant Grade-1 posts. Candidates who appeared in the Computer Based Test can now check the shortlisted candidates list for skill test, personal interview and document verification. Read this blog to get the merit list PDF links and information on how to check the result, minimum qualifying marks and what’s next after CBT result.

NPCIL Result 2026 Out

NPCIL has published the list of shortlisted candidates for various posts on its official website. Candidates selected in the CBT have been called for the next stages including skill test, personal interview and document verification. Individual marks obtained in the online examination will be released shortly through the candidate login.

How to Check NPCIL Result 2026?

Candidates can download the NPCIL result PDF from the official website by following these simple steps.

  1. Visit the official NPCIL career website.
  2. Open the recruitment section.
  3. Click on the Kakrapar Gujarat Site recruitment notice.
  4. Select the result or shortlisted candidates link.
  5. Download the PDF file.
  6. Search your roll number or registration number.
  7. Save the result PDF for future use.

Details Mentioned on NPCIL Result 2026

The NPCIL result PDF contains important information about the shortlisted candidates. Candidates should verify all details carefully.

  • Candidate name
  • Roll number/Registration number
  • Post name
  • Category
  • Selection status
  • Next stage details
  • Interview or skill test information
  • Document verification instructions

NPCIL Score Card 2026

NPCIL will soon release the NPCIL Score Card 2026 on its official website for candidates who appeared in the Computer Based Test. Candidates will be able to know their marks by logging in with their registration number & password. The scorecard will show section wise marks, total marks obtained, qualifying status and other important details. Candidates should download and keep a copy of the scorecard for future recruitment stages.

What After NPCIL 2026 Result?

Candidates who have qualified in the NPCIL result will now appear for the next stage of the recruitment process. ST/TN and Assistant Grade-1 candidates will undergo the skill test and ST/SA candidates will appear for the personal interview. Candidates will be called for document verification after successfully clearing these stages. The final merit list will then be made as per recruitment rules and selected candidates will get appointment offers.

NPCIL Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When was the NPCIL Result 2026 released?

NPCIL Result is declared on 27th June 2026 for various posts under Kakrapar Gujarat Site recruitment.

Q2. How many vacancies are announced under NPCIL Recruitment 2026?

A total of 197 vacancies have been announced.

Q3. Which posts are covered under the NPCIL Result 2026?

The result covers ST/SA, ST/TN and Assistant Grade-1 posts.

Q4. What is the next stage after the NPCIL 2026 result?

Qualified candidates have to appear for skill test, personal interview and document verification depending on the post.

Q5. Will NPCIL release individual marks?

Yes, NPCIL has informed that individual CBT marks will be made available via candidate login soon.

Q6. Is the NPCIL skill test qualifying in nature?

Yes, the skill test is qualifying in nature for eligible posts.

Q7. How is the final merit list prepared?

The final merit list is prepared according to the post-wise selection process and marks obtained in the prescribed stages.
